name: Two-Level Stacking
description: Replaces the flat prediction_ensemble node with a two-level stacking architecture. Level 1 models produce out-of-fold predictions that become features for a level 2 meta-learner. This is the 'stacking' pattern used in most top Kaggle ensembles.

with_nodes.name: collect_oof_predictions
with_nodes.description: Collect out-of-fold predictions from all level 1 models into a meta-feature matrix. Each column is one model's OOF predictions.

with_nodes.name: train_meta_learner
with_nodes.description: Train a simple meta-learner (typically Ridge, LogisticRegression, or linear blend) on the meta-feature matrix. Must be simple to avoid overfitting to the stacking layer.

with_nodes.name: meta_predict
with_nodes.description: Generate test predictions from all level 1 models, stack them, and predict with the meta-learner.

notes: Requires kfold_ensemble expansion first (to produce OOF predictions). The meta-learner must be simple — complex meta-learners overfit to the stacking signal. Ridge or linear blend with optimized weights is standard.
